jobs.title: AI Creative Producer
jobs.description:
Description: 
 PETA’s Video Lab is a team of creative problem-solvers and storytellers behind some of the organization’s most talked-about animal rights videos on social media. From provocative, hilarious content that taps into the cultural conversation to emotionally powerful stories that motivate people to act, the Video Lab creates work that consistently cuts through the noise. Videos produced by PETA’s Video Lab generate roughly 100 million views each year, offering an extraordinary opportunity to experiment with emerging creative technology and make work that has a meaningful impact on animals.


  Position Description:


 PETA’s social channels reach millions of people every week—and this role sits at the center of that impact. As an AI Creative Producer — Social Video, you’ll create visually striking, culturally relevant, and emotionally powerful videos for PETA’s social platforms, with a strong emphasis on AI-assisted animation, original visual storytelling, and self-filmed content.


 Your work will help make PETA’s animal liberation message compelling, shareable, and impossible to ignore—whether through humor and provocative commentary or powerful stories that build empathy for animals and inspire people to take action.


 We’re looking for a highly creative, chronically online producer with strong creative instincts and a genuine connection to PETA’s mission. You should be excited to experiment with emerging AI tools and develop work that can be bold, funny, unexpected, heartbreaking, or moving, all via a new creative medium. Above all, you should understand that technology is a tool for telling great stories and helping people see animals as individuals.


  Position Objective:


 Leverage AI tools to create bold content, appear on camera, create skits, commentary, explanatory videos, and more


  Primary Responsibilities and Duties:


 
  Create high-impact videos for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube, and emerging social channels, from concept through final delivery
  Develop scripts and creative concepts that balance humor, cultural relevance, emotional resonance, and provocative storytelling
  Use AI tools such as Midjourney, Runway, Higgsfield, Veo, and similar platforms to create animations, characters, visual effects, and other elements that elevate storytelling
  Experiment with emerging AI-powered video, animation, and creative technologies to develop innovative content and formats
  Combine AI-generated elements with traditional editing, animation, self-shot footage, and other production techniques to create the strongest possible story
  Create characters for comedic skits, commentary, explanatory videos, and other original formats that bring PETA’s bold and distinctive voice to life
  Develop emotionally compelling stories that build empathy for animals, help audiences see them as individuals, and motivate people to take action
  Self-film content when needed, using an iPhone or similar equipment, taking ownership of lighting, sound, props, set design, and overall production quality
  Direct and produce formal shoots as needed
  Collaborate closely with Video Lab team members and the social media team to develop timely, engaging content
  Ensure all video content meets quality standards and complies with legal and brand guidelines
  Stay current on social media trends, platform updates, internet culture, and advancements in AI creative tools
  Requirements: 
 
  Degree in a related field, relevant professional experience, or a portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative ability
  Portfolio showcasing generative AI work, creative video projects, or personal AI-driven experiments. We care about what you’ve made, whether it comes from professional work, social content, animations, spec pieces, short films, or personal projects
  Demonstrated experience using AI tools for video generation, animation, visual effects, or video enhancement
  Strong understanding of visual storytelling and all stages of video production, from concept development through post-production
  Excellent video-editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or comparable tools
  Familiarity with video, lighting, and photography equipment
  Excellent creative instincts and enthusiasm for bold, unconventional ideas, balanced with the judgment and empathy needed to tell sensitive and emotionally powerful stories
  Strong understanding of social media and what makes audiences stop, watch, feel, and share
  Curiosity about emerging creative technology and enthusiasm for experimenting with new tools and techniques
  Knowledge of animal rights issues and familiarity with PETA campaigns preferred
  Professional appearance and commitment to a healthy vegan lifestyle
  Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively under tight deadlines, both independently and collaboratively
  Commitment to the mission and objectives of the organization
 
 The hourly pay range for this position is $19.45 - $24.93. The ultimate hourly pay within this range offered to a qualified candidate will be determined by the candidate’s experience.


 A list of benefits available to qualified employees is available here.


 


 

    Application Deadline:


 Applications for this position will be accepted until September 17, 2026.


 We may fill this job opening before the deadline if we find a qualified candidate.

We're hiring an AI Creative Producer to help our AI startup create and display our visual brand through heavy AI-powered creative. This is a unique opportunity to shape how we show up in the market.

SummaryFlexible Title: Can be tailored to reflect your skills & experience.Flexible Time: Can do full-time, part-time, side-gig (off-hours), or fractional (contract).Flexible Commitment: Can do short-term, long-term, or intermittent.Why so flexible? We're a FUNDED startup racing to launch end of Q2 2026. That gives us just 3 months to stack features while raising additional working capital. Feel free to jump in, help us ship, then bounce >> or stick around. A successful launch translates into lots of permanent jobs for those who want them. We're also interested in long-term "side gig" relationships, if that's what you're into — in our experience, a few expert hours often beat full-time learning-curve hours.

About UsWe're a credible, funded, remote-first startup led by a serial technical founder, backed by a 20-person team. The product is live in private alpha. Learn more at list-lab.org.

We're currently operating in stealth under an existing brand and will gradually evolve into a new public-facing identity as we validate the right direction.

About The RoleThis is a senior-level, creative-director-type role focused on video. You'll work from our existing visual brand and campaign briefs to produce:

Video — short-form promotional and social video, product explainers, ad creative, and motion content.Design — ad graphics, social assets, display and paid-social creative, and content formats that we can iterate on quickly with performance data.Campaign and program support — stand up and run promotional campaigns, content series, and advertising programs by generating and iterating on creative at volume.You combine video marketing know-how with AI-powered creation to get campaigns and ad programs into the market quickly. Startup or high-growth experience is important — we move fast and priorities shift.

CompensationUp to $150,000 max total engagement in Tier 1 cities (cash and equity mix to be negotiated). Rate or retainer based on scope and availability; we're open to equity for the right long-term fractional fit.

jobs.title: Creative Producer for Game Ad Creative, Part Time Ongoing - Contract to Hire
jobs.description:
We are a US based creative agency producing performance ad creative for mobile and PC game publishers. We are adding a creative producer to run three active game accounts.

This is a creative ownership role. You will study each game, develop the angles we test, write the scripts and hooks, build shot lists for gameplay capture, and direct our editor and AI generation work through to delivery. Roughly four to eight pieces of video and static creative per account per month plus hook variations.

You are not working alone. We have an editor, a capture operator, a social manager, and a media buying partner already on these accounts.

Requirements: three or more years producing advertising creative, strong preference for game or app work. Excellent written English, since you are writing the ad copy. Demonstrated use of AI video and image generation in finished client work. Comfort giving notes on edit and motion work. Four hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time.

This starts part time and grows to full time as our slate expands. We are looking for a long term relationship, not a one off project.

When you apply, describe one ad you personally concepted and produced, including the brief, the angle you chose, and how it performed. Include three links to work you directed. Begin your proposal with the word Riftstone.

Screening questions to add in the Upwork form:

Which AI video or image generation tools have you used in paid client work, and on what?

Describe a time a piece of creative underperformed. What did you change and what happened?

What hours can you reliably overlap with US Pacific time?

jobs.title: Lead Creative Producer
jobs.description:
About usRuby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/



About the roleWe are looking for a superhero-level Lead Ad Creative Producer to lead and control the entire creative production operation at one of Ruby Labs’ fastest-growing consumer products.

This is a producing lead (player-coach) role. You produce winning ad creatives with your own hands and you run the production operation. This role is not about writing briefs and coordinating — it is about conversion, control, standards, and consistency at scale, with your own creatives setting the bar for the team.

You will own the creative production process end-to-end: how creatives are ideated, designed, reviewed, refined, approved, and delivered. You are accountable for winning creatives, creative quality, execution speed, compliance, and production discipline. You will work directly with User Acquisition Managers and manage a team of a creative producer and designers, acting as the final creative quality and compliance guard before any asset reaches testing or traffic.



Core MissionDeliver a reliable stream of winning ad creatives by concentrating production volume on proven winning angles, while running a disciplined, fully traceable, compliant production operation — from ideation to launch.



Key Responsibilities

Creative Production LeadershipPersonally produce ad creatives — concepts, hooks, scripts, and finished assets — alongside the team. This is a producing lead role, not a coordination role.

Own end-to-end ad creative production execution across all formats (static, video, UGC, motion, AI-generated creatives).

Act as the final approval authority for all creatives before testing or launch.

Ensure all creatives meet:

Brand and visual standards

Pixel perfect design

Platform-specific best practices and compliance requirements for Meta, Snapchat, and Google

Clear UI / visual hierarchy

Performance-oriented execution

Creative Process Management & MonitoringDesign, enforce, and continuously improve the creative production workflow.

Monitor creative work during production.

Identify execution risks, quality drops, or bottlenecks early and resolve them immediately.

Maintain consistent production speed without sacrificing quality.

Keep all production traceable in a single tracking system.

Creative Quality Assurance & Feedback OwnershipProvide continuous written feedback to producers and designers throughout the production process.

Ensure feedback is:

Clear

Specific

Actionable

Actively guide creatives while they are being produced, preventing rework and quality regressions.

Uphold a consistently high creative bar across all outputs.

Creative Development & Ideation & ControlLead ideation and conceptualization of new ad creatives.

Translate strategic direction and performance insights into creative briefs.

Stay current with AI-driven creative tools, formats, and industry trends.

Work closely with User Acquisition Managers to understand creative performance signals.

Incorporate performance feedback into creative improvements and future concepts.

Support testing strategies by delivering clear, test-ready creative variations.

Market & Competitor Creative IntelligenceContinuously research competitor creatives across consumer tech markets.

Benchmark creative quality, formats, hooks, and execution approaches.

Apply relevant insights to elevate internal creative standards.

Cross-Team CoordinationAct as the execution bridge between:

Producers and designers

User Acquisition Managers

Ensure alignment, clarity of expectations, and smooth handoffs across teams.

Reporting & AccountabilityProvide regular updates to the management of the company:

Creative pipeline status

Production velocity

Quality consistency

Take ownership of creative execution outcomes and continuously raise standards.



Qualifications

Experience3+ years of experience with OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence) products — you understand what drives people to search for information about others and themselves, and can translate that into creative angles.

Proven hands-on experience producing ad creatives for Meta, Snapchat, and Google campaigns.

Proven experience managing multi-format, high-volume creative pipelines.

Strong portfolio of performance-driven digital ads with numbers attached (spend, CPA, ROI).

Experience in restricted or compliance-sensitive ad categories is a strong plus.

Technical & AI SkillsDeep understanding of Meta and Google advertising policies and compliance — including restricted content categories, misleading ad design rules, and personal-attributes limitations — with proven experience keeping high-volume accounts in good standing.

Ability to judge, before launch, whether a creative will pass platform review, and to redesign concepts that won't without losing their conversion power.

Solid understanding of paid advertising platforms and creative performance metrics (CPA, ROI, CTR, spend concentration).

Hands-on daily use of AI tools across the production stack: image generation, video generation, avatars/UGC, scripting.

Ability to evaluate creative quality objectively against data, not subjectively against taste.

Personal ProfileExceptional attention to detail and high personal standards for quality and execution.

Clear, direct communicator who acts on feedback within days, not months.

Comfortable enforcing structure, compliance, and creative discipline.

Thrives in fast-moving, high-expectation environments.
